method: Goals are inferred from each page's registry tagline, blurb and kind. They are working statements for review; success measures are targets to test, not measured results. stable_edge_checks list what to evaluate against primary sources (browser Baseline data, MDN, research) before adopting; nothing is adopted until measured, tested and reversible.
